spec.name: Merja Bargha Lake
spec.description: A significant coastal wetland and Ramsar site located south of Larache. Part of the Loukkos estuary complex, it is a vital habitat for migratory birds and is historically linked to the mythical Garden of the Hesperides.

timeline.title: Agricultural Development
timeline.description: The surrounding plains began to be developed for farming by the Agricultural Company of Loukkos.

timeline.title: Irrigation Project
timeline.description: Launch of the R'mel irrigation sector, which significantly altered the lake's hydrology.

timeline.title: Ramsar Designation
timeline.description: Designated as a Wetland of International Importance under the Ramsar Convention.
